استحضروا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْضَرُوا (istaḥḍarū) /is.taħ.dˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
# اُسْتُحْضِرُوا (ustuḥḍirū) /us.tuħ.dˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
# اِسْتَحْضِرُوا (istaḥḍirū) /is.taħ.dˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْضَرَ (istaḥḍara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
